findings.evidence: “Test: an assertion failure. Name the test and expected versus actual values” and “Build: a compile, type or lint error. Name the file and line” repeat standard CI-triage knowledge. Much of the Procedure is ordinary log-reading and classification advice; the source-revision check and evidence gates supply the stronger knowledge delta.
findings.fix: Condense the familiar class definitions into a compact taxonomy. Preserve the evidence gates, commit verification and gotchas, and replace generic triage prose with concrete causal rules for supported CI formats, such as correlating diagnostics with the failed matrix step rather than global log order.

findings.evidence: “the earliest of `Error`, `FAILED`, `Traceback`, `exit code`, `npm ERR!`, `##[error]`” defines a narrow marker search without a no-match fallback. A compiler-only log containing lowercase `error TS2322` or `fatal error:` can contain a genuine build failure but none of these markers; that branch has no specified investigation path before Inconclusive.
findings.fix: Treat these markers as initial search hints rather than an exhaustive set. If none identifies a confirmed failure, search case-insensitively for compiler and assertion diagnostics and inspect failed-step summaries. Return Inconclusive only after that fallback search cannot establish a cause.
